pipeline: openWakeWord-compatible: 16 kHz PCM -> melspectrogram.onnx (32 bins, 8 frames per 80 ms) -> embedding_model.onnx (76 frames -> 96 values) -> eve_ecoute_moi.json (16 x 96 window)

melspectrogram.onnx.license: Apache-2.0 (openWakeWord code); fixed-parameter transform. To verify: license not stated separately from the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 notice that covers openWakeWord's pre-trained wake-word models.

embedding_model.onnx.license: Re-implementation of Google's speech_embedding (TFHub, Apache-2.0). To verify: license not stated separately from the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 notice that covers openWakeWord's pre-trained wake-word models.

eve_ecoute_moi.json.source: Trained for atome/eVe on 2026-10-12 with temp/wake_training (JavaScript, Node, onnxruntime-web 1.27.0), see eVe/documentations/assistant_wake_provisioning.md
trainingVoices: Piper fr_FR-siwis-medium, SIWIS French Speech Synthesis Database, CC BY 4.0, https://datashare.is.ed.ac.uk/handle/10283/2353
Piper fr_FR-mls-medium, Multilingual LibriSpeech French (openslr.org/94), CC BY 4.0
FLEURS fr_fr (Google), CC BY 4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/fleurs — natural speech used as negatives only
eve_ecoute_moi.json.negativeText: French strings of the application's own i18n catalogue and generated syllables
eve_ecoute_moi.json.architecture: 1536 -> 32 -> 32 -> 1 (ReLU, sigmoid), inputs standardized; Adam, 20 epochs, batch 128, lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, negative weight 4, seed 11
eve_ecoute_moi.json.trainingData: 11,996 positive windows (siwis + 14 screened mls speakers), 73,924 synthetic negative windows, 43,596 natural-speech windows (FLEURS fr_fr test, CC BY 4.0)
eve_ecoute_moi.json.policy: threshold 0.99 on 2 consecutive 80 ms frames; personal verifier gated at base >= 0.3, threshold 0.5
eve_ecoute_moi.json.evaluation: macOS voices never used for training (18 fr_FR/fr_CA voices, 108 phrase clips at 6/15/30 dB SNR, 23 min of continuous read speech): 107/108 detected, 0 false activations in 23 min (threshold 0.98: 108/108, 1 false activation). Same with the silence gate. Real browser chain (Chromium fake microphone): Thomas, Amélie, Jacques detected once per loop, a long negative sentence never.
